title: [Inductor][NVGEMM] Enable disk cache for EFC kernel artifacts
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #187013
* #185967
* #185966
* #185965
* #186184
* #186183

EFC (Epilogue Fusion Compatible) kernels compile to a Python closure
wrapping a TVMFFIJitCompiledFunction. The closure captures the kernel's
EFC JIT object for runtime argument packing. Previously, disk_cache_set
called export_to_c on the closure, which failed (AttributeError), so
EFC artifacts were only cached in-process and recompiled on every
process restart.

Fix: unwrap the inner JIT function before serialization and reconstruct
the closure at load time. The kernel object (and its impl.efc.jit) is
already available from the kernel cache, so we only need to persist the
compiled GPU binary.

_unwrap_efc_compiled_obj extracts the inner TVMFFIJitCompiledFunction
from the closure for disk serialization. _rewrap_efc_compiled_obj
reconstructs the wrapped_launch closure from a loaded JIT function and
the kernel's EFC JIT object.

Non-EFC kernels are unaffected -- both functions pass through unchanged
when the compiled_obj is already a JIT function.

Authored with the help of an AI assistant (Claude).

Test Plan:
```
python test/inductor/test_nv_universal_gemm.py TestNVUniversalGemmEpilogueFusion.test_efc_disk_cache_round_trip -v
python test/inductor/test_nv_universal_gemm.py TestNVUniversalGemmEpilogueFusion -v
```
